claims.description: Tau codebase-ingest records scan/projection lifecycle receipts and blocks/adapts across cancellation, restart, dead-worker, liveness, mutation, and receipt-mismatch boundaries.
Tau Python host-call bridge executes through the real kernel profile while enforcing generation, binding, path, graph-query, evidence-emission, undeclared-call, and late-request authority boundaries.
Tau Python workspace kernel runs the worker and backend lifecycle through the real optional Jupyter profile while enforcing capability, binding, import failure, interrupt, and PID reuse boundaries.

Tau content-addresses retained agentic-eval reports and report-referenced artifacts, records report commands and runner schema version, binds report source SHA/ref and checkout dirty-tree declarations, and verifies the retained evidence fail-closed.
Tau executes a local goal-bound DAG through the CLI, writes a ledger, verifies it intact, and rejects tampering.
Tau names the five packaged DAG rungs and proves rung 1 from a separate clean checkout with independent artifact readback and negative controls.
ops-discord failures preserve machine-readable status and visible repair overlay state.
Repeated human-adjudication routing for the same repair category does not create duplicate external notifications.
Discord collaboration state is typed and can unblock only through a matching answer receipt, not through status text.
Tau keeps a machine-checkable source feature inventory reconciled against capability claims, retained reports, duplicate ownership, orphan manifests, and expiring non-coverage records.
Default Tau DAG runs emit a verifiable traceable run ledger.
A required-node failure becomes a blocking pipeline-self-repair category instead of a blind retry or skipped downstream edge.
Tau exposes governed refinement preview, apply, verify, rollback, conformance, and read-only view commands with live Memory-backed conformance proof.
Repair collaboration state is visible in the browser viewer rather than hidden in local JSON only.
Repair closure authorizes a rerun of the same semantic node instead of skipping to downstream work.
A terminal operator can watch Tau DAG progress from authoritative Tau dag-progress.json using the PHART DAG chart skill without mutating run state.
Tau DAG viewer timeline renders a live browser proof path and preserves admission/execution separation plus selector uniqueness under adversarial cases.
